It's not a workaround or a temporary fix, but rather a permanent structural alternative that empowers creators to own their infrastructure and maintain control over their online businesses. By leveraging free and open-source tools, sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a cost-effective and scalable solution for creators who want to sell digital products online without relying on platform restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. At the core, it relies on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments, a crypto payment processor, handles automatic on-chain payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This modular architecture allows creators to deploy a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
